title: Multiple mineral horizons in layered outcrops at Mawrth Vallis, Mars, signify changing geochemical environments on early Mars

text:
Bibliographic record (Crossref metadata, not the paper's full text): Multiple mineral horizons in layered outcrops at Mawrth Vallis, Mars, signify changing geochemical environments on early Mars.

Authors: Janice L. Bishop, Christoph Gross, Jacob Danielsen, Mario Parente, Scott L. Murchie, Briony Horgan, James J. Wray, Christina Viviano, Frank P. Seelos.
